style: Matches the first ProAxis promo (videos/proaxis-motion): deep navy/indigo field with seeded constellation network, hairline grid and drifting indigo/purple glows; white Montserrat 700/900 headlines with indigo->purple gradient emphasis; JetBrains Mono small-caps kickers; glassy dark UI panels; green checks; double-chevron mark + ProAxis wordmark; chevron wipe bands on the major cuts; one orange CTA pill.
font: Montserrat (400/700/800/900) display, JetBrains Mono (400/700) kickers/numerals; both HF-bundled

beat_grid.note: every scene cut is a whole beat: 2.4, 4.4, 10.0, 12.8, 15.2, 17.6

brief: A ~20s product promo for ProAxis Standalone (run your own call exchange). The chevron mark assembles over a drawing constellation with a NEW · PROAXIS STANDALONE pill, a chevron band sweeps into 'Turn every call into revenue.', then the hero: a live routing sequence built as glassy UI cards wired left to right. A publisher's call rings in, travels down a routing line into a live auction where three bids tick in and Pipe Pros wins in 0.2s, travels on to the buyer who connects (timer runs to 4:12, Billable), and the money strip resolves the margin: $32 in, $20 out, you keep $12. AI Verdict cards contrast a qualified and a rejected call, a campaign card switches on four pricing models, four stat tiles count up, and a final chevron sweep lands the ProAxis lockup with 'Your publishers. Your buyers. Your margin.' and the orange CTA, holding still to the end. Dominant motion idea: the call travelling left to right along the chevron 'push'.
